subject: Re: Life Insurance Inquiry — Updated Contact Details
body:
Dear Herr Müller,

Thank you for the detailed information you sent last month. I apologize for the delayed response — I have been busy with my relocation.

I wanted to let you know that I have now completed my move to Germany. My new address is:

Leopoldstraße 15, Apt 4B
80802 München

I have also started a new position as a Senior Software Engineer at TechCorp GmbH here in Munich. My new work email is maria.garcia@email.com — please use this address for all future correspondence instead of my old Gmail.

I am still very interested in the term life insurance policy we discussed (Option B with the 500,000€ coverage). Could we schedule a call next week to finalize the details?

I enjoy hiking in the Alps on weekends now that I live in Munich — it has been wonderful for my mental health. I suppose that's relevant for the health questionnaire!

Best regards,
Maria García López
